bills.title: Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-11-27.51.1) to agree with the main idea of the bill. In other words, they voted in favour of reading the bill for a second time. ### What is the bill's main idea? According to the [bill homepage](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7248), the bill was: > *Introduced with the Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin) Bill 2024 and Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024, the bill imposes charges to recover the cost of providing services that benefit groups of Guarantee of Origin scheme participants.* According to the [explanatory memorandum](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fems%2Fr7248_ems_8e7da15b-1235-451d-8dbc-b5082ba5aa17%22;rec=0) (which is a political document produced by the party introducing it): > *The Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Charges) Bill 2024 (GO Charges Bill) is part of a package of three Bills, including the Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin) Bill 2024 (GO Bill) and the Future Made in Australia (Guarantee of Origin Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2024 that are intended to be introduced to the Parliament concurrently .* > > *The Bill package would provide a framework for the establishment of a Guarantee of Origin (GO) scheme that would track and verify attributes associated with low-emissions products, starting with hydrogen, and establish an enduring certification mechanism for renewable electricity. Participants that opt in to the GO scheme, who produce low-emissions products or renewable electricity, would be able to create certificates that contain information about their emissions or renewable attributes that would be tracked through a public register providing greater
